caption: Open source
heading: Built in public
description: Interactive visualizations, AI video tooling, and minimal, readable PyTorch implementations of recent ML research papers.

featured.name: Algo Vision
featured.description: Twenty-two interactive visualizations of how things actually compute — from bubble sort to Raft consensus, from Bloom filters to the Bloch sphere. Pause anywhere and read the pseudocode in lockstep.

tools.name: Reference Packer
tools.description: Packs several reference images into one clean sheet per subject for AI video on Higgsfield, lints it for lighting and resolution, and builds the prompt for Seedance, Kling, Wan, Veo or Gemini Omni. Runs entirely in the browser; Python CLI included.

series.name: Node.js security
